split_strategy: StratifiedGroupKFold grouped by facility/medicine pair (60/20/20 train/validation/test)
selection_policy: F2-first with a precision floor: choose the model and threshold with the highest validation F2 (recall weighted twice precision) among operating points whose precision is at least the configured floor; break ties on recall, then ROC-AUC. Accuracy is reported but is not the selection criterion.
limitations: Trained only on synthetic data from ml/data_generation.py. Metrics describe this simulation, not real-world performance.
The simulation is deliberately simpler than a real supply chain: demand, lead times, and replenishment follow stylised distributions.
The threshold is chosen on a validation split and the test split is small, so the held-out metrics carry wide uncertainty.
Facility, region, and medicine are one-hot encoded. Unseen categories at inference are ignored and rely on numeric features.
Predicted probabilities are not calibrated for operational decision thresholds.
The model predicts a 30-day stockout indicator only. It does not recommend transfers and does not replace the deterministic rules.
Human review by an authorized supply-chain professional is required before any operational action.
